WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793221581781
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826381781
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview')
)
SELECT bucket, bd, COUNT(*) AS agg
FROM (SELECT ((ts_ms / 86400000) * 86400000) AS bucket, '' AS bd, pid, session_id, NULL AS val
    FROM ev WHERE 1 = 1) t
GROUP BY bucket, bd
ORDER BY bucket
LIMIT 50000

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793221581781
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826381781
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview')
)
SELECT bd, COUNT(*) AS agg
FROM (SELECT ((ts_ms / 86400000) * 86400000) AS bucket, '' AS bd, pid, session_id, NULL AS val
    FROM ev WHERE 1 = 1) t
GROUP BY bd
ORDER BY agg DESC
LIMIT 1000
